summary: A typed, effect-aware tool contract removes guesswork at the model-to-computer boundary and produces evidence that orchestration can reason about.

points.text: MCP demonstrates the practical baseline: tools expose named operations with JSON-Schema-defined inputs and structured results instead of relying only on prose conventions.
Schema validation is necessary but not sufficient. Effect class, idempotency, postconditions and stable error categories are what make retries and recovery safe.
Bounded observations and artifact references preserve the detail needed for audit without forcing every raw response into the active context window.
